current: Air-dried cured beef coated with a cumin-forward çemen paste; 'Kayseri Pastırması' has been a registered geographical indication since 2002.
proposed: Air-dried cured beef coated with çemen, a paste of fenugreek, cumin, garlic and hot paprika; 'Kayseri Pastırması' has been a registered geographical indication since 2002.
note: GI fact verified (TURKPATENT detail/37898: no. 36, 25.06.2002). The cited page has no recipe text; cemen is fenugreek-based (the word means fenugreek), so 'cumin-forward' is misleading.

current: The geographer Strabo was born in Amasya and wrote that its rock tombs belonged to the kings of Pontus.
proposed: The geographer Strabo was born in Amasya (ancient Amaseia) and left a full description of the city in his Geography.

current: Arch dam on the Çoruh River near Yusufeli, 270 m high, operational at the end of 2022 and the highest dam in Turkey as of 2023.
proposed: Arch dam on the Çoruh River near Yusufeli, 275 m high from its foundation; the reservoir began to fill in November 2022 and it is the highest dam in Turkey.
